script:
set +e; sudo -u azureuser bash -lc 'cat > /tmp/giv_tiers.py << PYEOF
import re
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
URL = "https://e.givesmart.com/events/KHN/"
with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True, args=["--no-sandbox"])
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={"width":1400,"height":2400})
    page.goto(URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000)
    page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    page.locator("text=BUY TICKETS").first.click(timeout=5000)
    page.wait_for_timeout(4000)
    # The ticket cards usually have a card class. Pull text from each card-like region.
    html = page.content()
    # Reduce to text, preserving block boundaries with newlines for elements.
    import html as hh
    h = html
    h = re.sub(r"<script[^>]*>.*?</script>", "", h, flags=re.S)
    h = re.sub(r"<style[^>]*>.*?</style>", "", h, flags=re.S)
    h = re.sub(r"<(br|/p|/div|/li|/tr|/td|/h\\d)[^>]*>", "\\n", h, flags=re.I)
    h = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", h)
    h = hh.unescape(h)
    h = re.sub(r"[ \\t]+", " ", h)
    h = re.sub(r"\\n\\s*\\n+", "\\n", h)
    # Now find tier blocks: a tier name, then $ amount, then attendees per ticket.
    # Known tier names from prior scrape:
    tiers = ["Gala Attendee", "Table of 10 Guests", "Sponsor a Medical Student", "Sponsor a PASD Patient", "Title Sponsor", "Impact Story Sponsor", "Gold Sponsor", "Silver Sponsor", "Bronze Sponsor", "Dinner Sponsor", "Project Access Patient Sponsor", "Photography Sponsor", "Reception Sponsor"]
    for t in tiers:
        for m in re.finditer(re.escape(t)+r"(.{1,400})", h, flags=re.S|re.I):
            seg = re.sub(r"\\s+", " ", m.group(1)).strip()
            # Take everything up to the first occurrence of the NEXT tier name to avoid bleed
            cut = len(seg)
            for t2 in tiers:
                if t2 == t: continue
                idx = seg.find(t2)
                if idx > 0 and idx < cut: cut = idx
            seg = seg[:cut].strip()
            print(f"==> {t}: {seg[:350]}")
            break
    browser.close()
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/giv_tiers.py 2>&1'
